name: Megami Ryoujoku ~Koukou Souryo Skuld~
original_name: 女神凌辱 ～肛交僧侶スクルド～
source:
Skuld is an oracle. One day, her country is invaded by monsters and Skuld is kept hostage by them. Roki says, "Follow my orders if you don't wanna die." Her power will disappear if she loses her virginity.... "Ok, you entertain me with your another 'hole'...."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090228211117/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012146]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
诗蔻蒂是一名女祭司。一天，她的国家遭到魔物入侵，自己也沦为人质。洛基对她说：“不想死就服从我的命令。”一旦失去处女之身，她的力量便会消失……“好吧，那就用你的另一个‘洞’取悦我……”

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090228211117/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012146]Eroge Shop[/url]]
